cost: Sum actual layer costs: greedy frame alignment O(parsed*realized*lemma bytes), world sentence grouping potentially quadratic in frames and quote membership, local-tree sorting sum degree log degree, report cell sorting; annotation/model/I/O costs explicitly unmeasured. World decode_exact also costs O(S*Z+S) time for S requested sentences and Z retained empty-sentence indices, with O(S) output vectors; all-empty input gives quadratic membership comparisons despite zero frames.
description: pipeline composes world decode_exact -> Realizer.sentence -> frames.apply -> tree.decode_exact -> vol.decode_blocks. Frame scripts transport realized origins into parsed heads; world residuals restore global frames and local sentence links. report consumes Tally; CLI selects groups/options and merges per-volume tallies.
forward: pipeline composes world decode_exact -> Realizer.sentence -> frames.apply -> tree.decode_exact -> vol.decode_blocks. Frame scripts transport realized origins into parsed heads; world residuals restore global frames and local sentence links. report consumes Tally; CLI selects groups/options and merges per-volume tallies.

Real joins are pipeline -> frames/tree/world/tally, main -> pipeline/report, tests -> synthetic layer APIs. class supplies labels/costs. lib exposes API/path; reporting and path assembly are tagged independent from codec reconstruction. Root owns volume/mixed sibling joins.
inverse: Exact_ok cannot follow an earlier retained representation mismatch; normal mode cannot recover omitted residual fields by assertion. No persistence/learning effects are performed by pure residual helpers.
Encoder-produced residuals with stable state give compatible original sentence/tree/frame witnesses; tally and normal text admit many antecedents.
limitations: Finite native checks and partial syntax only; no universal proof.
No useful executable percentage surrogate; future caps1/2/5/10% require a defined metric.
Tally formatting, static exports and model_path do not certify end-to-end behavior.
state: Exact diagnostic reconstruction requires matching decoder flags/state and all residuals; normal decode and report scores are separate observations. No persistent knowledge or semantic equivalence is implied.
